mapper.select: select * from campus where campus_name like concat('%', #{campusName} ,'%')

select province_name, city_name, district_name, street_name, village_name, un_name, campus_id, campus_name from campus join university on campus_university = un_id join village on village_id = un_village join street on village_street = street_id join district on street_district = district_id join city on district_city = city_id join province on city_province = province_id where campus_name like concat('%', #{campusName} ,'%')
